_schema.cols: column keys in printed order: date, vdate(value date), ref(cheque/ref no), desc, type(txn type code), debit, credit, amount(single signed/unsigned), balance, branch, fee, chan(channel), status, code, cat(category)
_schema.date: row date pattern: DD MM YY YYYY MON(Jan) MONTH(January); no year => year inferred from period
_schema.amt: split=debit/credit columns | signed=leading minus | plusminus=+/- both | drcr=Dr/Cr suffix on amount | trail=trailing minus | parens=(x) negative | section=direction from section heading
_schema.bal_sfx: suffix on balance: '' | Cr | CR | cr | D(overdrawn) | +- | trail(-)
_schema.wrap: where the date sits in a wrapped row: top | bottom ; amt_line: first | last line carrying amounts
_schema.hdr: page header block: all=repeats every page | first=page 1 only | partial
_schema.thdr: table column header repeats on each page
_schema.blank_same_day: date printed only on first row of a day
_schema.scanned_sample: sample is scanned (no text layer); unsupported (no OCR)
